boundaries.trust: Operation-owned canonical decision/key Maps; normal/update/clear and Windows conflicts release five observed Maps. Saved keys only receive native spelling normalization when legacy realpath still resolves to themselves; replacing a trusted directory with a link does not transfer trust. Nine saved keys + one cwd = 9 legacy / 10 native API calls; two updates = 9 legacy / 11 native, independent of ancestor count. Read does not write/migrate the file.
boundaries.display: Session list owns only matching path strings in a Set, replaced on list refresh and cleared on disposal. Config ResourceItem owns one identityKey, refreshed at explicit toggle. No global cache or pool.
boundaries.mutation: Deletion confirmation resolves current filesystem identity again; configuration toggle refreshes identity before existing override selection/writes. Junction retarget regressions pass.
boundaries.frames: Native-only candidate regressed CPU about 30%; final candidate moves display identity work to load boundaries. Render path API counts 10/28→0/0. Thirty-row setup costs 91/60 native API calls, reported separately.
boundaries.lifetime: Frames collect while component remains alive; old identity Set collects after replacing the list; component collects after disposal/release. Config item identity strings have component ownership.
boundaries.platform: Windows real case-sensitive directory enabled successfully in local test; case/drive/8.3 short path/namespace/junction and distinct objects exercised. Remote UNC server not available and not claimed tested.
boundaries.retainedBaseline: Existing selector layout/override helper arrays/Sets/string formatting remain in sampled frame allocations. This change does not claim entire selector render has zero allocation; added per-frame closures/promises/controllers/wrappers/arrays are zero.
boundaries.order: Three old-source baseline runs, then three native-only runs, then three final candidate runs; setup excluded from frame timing. Initial source hash and base commit identify old UI source.

baseline.notes: Actual selector render consumers; existing layout/path work included. Setup and list loading excluded from timing. Native call counts are API calls, not OS syscall counts. Existing per-row path lookup is not claimed eliminated. Frames collect while selector lives; selector collects after disposal/release.
